Nora (Compliance): Heads-up — we need a vault inventory snapshot + staging smoke run this week for SOC2 fieldwork. Who can own the smoke and export inventory?
Aj (Eng-Infra): I can own the staging smoke. Thu 09:00 PT works for me. Need the inventory CSV and list of KMS/HSM endpoints. @Liam can you export?
Liam (SRE): Yep — will export from `vault-metadata` and include aliases + HSM endpoints. Command I usually run: `psql -h db-prod -U readonly -c "COPY (SELECT id, alias, endpoint, vendor FROM vault_metadata) TO STDOUT WITH CSV" > vault-snapshot.csv`
Maria (Security): For the smoke, also verify audit-log ingestion (kafka -> auditflow). I'll post a condensed checklist in a sec: https://redwood.internal/docs/compliance/vault-smoke
Nora (Compliance): Also need HSM attestation validation: perform a `sign` op and confirm corresponding audit entry + attestation blob exists.
deploy-bot: smoke job queued — id 202315 — env=staging — owner=@Aj — scheduled=2024-02-15T16:00:00Z
Aj (Eng-Infra): Plan to run these steps (quick):
```
# run vault smoke checks
./smoke/run_vault_checks.sh --env staging --keys s3://redwood-staging/compliance/vault-snapshot-170123.csv
# validate auditflow entries
./smoke/check_auditflow.sh --topic audit-logs --since 2024-02-15T16:00:00Z
```
Liam (SRE): Uploaded CSV to staging bucket: `s3://redwood-staging/compliance/vault-snapshot-170123.csv`. Shared IAM link to the team.
Nora (Compliance): Nice. One more ask — auditors want evidence for failures: timestamps, request IDs, and the raw audit entries. Can we capture those into a single archive?
Maria (Security): I can pull matching event IDs from auditflow and assemble a log bundle. If smoke finds failures I'll annotate each with why it failed and the mitigation.
Aj (Eng-Infra): If smoke passes I'll open a PR to update the `staging->fieldwork-ready` checklist and add links to the CSV + log bundle. cc @Nora @Maria
Nora (Compliance): Sweet. Thu 09:00 PT confirmed. Ping here immediately if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
Aj (Eng-Infra): Will do — I'll post results and attach the smoke run logs in this thread after completion.
